LONG-STAY: those reviews read as long-term residents; test 2 would fail: no posted nightly rate and no engine, and an RV Life tier doesn't stand in for a long-stay park. Stored RV Life 4.5*/$$ does not match the current Google picture.

RATE: no operator rate. The only figure is ParkAdvisor's undated '$34 full hookup', a directory, not usable. GS status not stated. Gate can't be read. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Indianapolis 41 km, just outside). Family has not stayed. I could not phone to ask whether it is still open; Google does not mark it closed.

WATER: stored 'riverfront' can't be confirmed for RV sites. Imagery shows the White River around a peninsula with a loose road network and a few scattered units, some near the bank, no hookup rows I could read. No operator page or site map exists. Pin 40.10490,-85.96550 is mid-peninsula, fine.
NAME: Google and directories call it 'River Bend Campground'; stored 'Riverbend Campground (Noblesville)'.

STORED FACTS UNVERIFIED: hookups 50A/water/sewer, pull_through, season and the note's 'open Apr-Dec' came from note prose off the dead site. No page contradicts them, so left in place; they should go with the entry if it is dropped, or be cleared on a phone check if not.
